query: Implement a client-interactive activity feed with TanStack Query. It polls every 15 seconds and supports infinite scrolling. The project uses Next.js App Router.
baseline_failure: Agent wraps a Server Action in useQuery and uses the action as the browser read and polling transport.
expected_behavior: Uses a GET Route Handler with explicit HTTP cache policy, or an explicit stream endpoint, as the browser-owned query transport
Keeps query keys, polling, pagination, and invalidation under the activity capability client segment and publishes a browser-safe client.ts surface
Keeps Server Actions for mutations and calls server-only read code directly from RSC-owned paths
Keeps Route Handler decoding local and calls an activity root public surface instead of importing modules/activity/server/**
anti_expectation: Does NOT add an HTTP self-call for an RSC-owned read
Does NOT move query data into Context, an external UI store, or local component state
Does NOT let app/** import capability-private schemas, auth helpers, stores, or composition files
